guide.header_subtitle: «Manual of controls, interface, narrative freedom, fate, and D&D 5e rules»
guide.chk_show_startup_tip: If unchecked, it won't open automatically. You can always open it with F1 or the '📖 Guide' button.
guide.tab_controls_html:
🎮 Quick Keyboard Shortcuts

[ C ] Full Character Sheet (D&D Beyond style): Opens your detailed character sheet with passive d20 rolls, features, spells, and background.
[ M ] Live 2D ASCII Map: Opens the full map in a resizable window. The minimap lives at the bottom of the right sheet and, if space is tight, leaves a button to open this modal. The world anchors on the starting room: walking moves [@], not the map.
[S] Button Simple ASCII map mode: Toggle inside the map showing only the current room and its direct neighbors, hiding rooms 2+ hops away.
[ F1 ] Guide & Manual: Opens this help window at any point during play.
[ Ctrl + / − / 0 ] Global Zoom: Scales the whole game UI up or down (chronicle, side sheet, buttons, map, and inventory), and Ctrl + 0 resets zoom. Mini buttons −, +, and ↺ next to the chronicle also work with the mouse. Inside the sheet, zoom also scales attributes, tables, and footer.
[ ↔ ] Draggable Splitters: Drag the handle between the chronicle and the side sheet to rebalance space. Inside the sheet, you can drag the handle between skills and tabs. The cursor switches to ↔ and the ratio is remembered.
[ Ctrl + , ] Interface Settings: Customize density, language (Español / English), font size, plateau check interval, and check for a newer engine release with 🔄 Check for updates (shows if you're up to date or the exact reason if the check fails). The window remembers its size and position: it opens proportional to your screen, shrinks down to 780x540, and recenters if you switch monitors.
[ Enter ] Submit Action: Sends the command or text typed in the action box to the Dungeon Master.
[ Esc ] Close Window: Closes any open modal dialog (sheet, settings, chronicle).
[ Ctrl + L ] Import License (.cantrip): Opens the offline file picker to activate a Supporter Edition license (also accessible under 🔑 AI Keys → License).

🖱️ Interactive Screen Elements

  • Tactical Action Bar: Quick shortcuts for ⚔️ Attack, 🛡️ Defend (+2 AC), 🏃 Flee, 🛌 Rest, and ❓ Ask DM. Wraps cleanly onto multiple rows on narrow windows.
  • Minimap, Points of Interest & Exits (Pointcrawl V2 + Spatial Sub-zones): Up top you see your current location and sub-zone (e.g., steps, wall, outside the cell). You can inspect or interact with [🔎 Point of Interest] buttons using any logical skill to uncover secrets or unlock routes. Multi-step routes unlock once all steps are solved. Adjacent connections show their state: [🚪 Exit], [🔒 Locked], [⚠️ Hazard], [⚡ Tension], or [🌫️ Rumor]. The engine constrains the DM to real topology, blocking impossible exits and enforcing containment until resolved.
  • 🗺️ Live 2D ASCII Map (toggle M): Grid anchored at the starting room with diorama rooms ([@], [◎], ◈/◇ foci, ☠ hazard, 💬/💬×N NPCs, ✦ loot, ✎ notes), corridors showing edge status (═🔒══, ──⚠──, ┄┄⋮┄┄), and fog banks ░▒▓ ? ▓▒░ over hidden paths. The right minimap lists active NPCs in the current room (party companions marked with ★) to draft a chat message on click. Inside the modal (M) the map sits on the left and all room details live in an adjustable right-hand panel: click foci 🔎, NPCs 💬, or open exits 🚪 to act right away, use ↑↓←→ or click any visited room to inspect its memory without spending a turn ([C] centers back on [@]), write personal notes (✎ Note), plot known routes (🧭 Plot route), and filter rooms (◈, 🔒, 💬, ✎). 100% local: spends zero tokens.
  • Side Panel & Draggable Splitters (↔ and ↕): Drag the horizontal splitter between chronicle and sheet (great for narrowing reading width on ultrawide monitors) and the vertical splitter between chronicle and inventory. Both tooltips appear only over their grip handles. Press 👤 Sheet (C) to toggle the side panel anytime.
  • Inventory & Items: Every item card shows its full name and properties without vertical clipping. Drag the vertical splitter up to display multiple rows, or click an item card to inspect, equip, consume, or ask the DM about it.
  • Hot Dynamic Zoom (+ / -): Zooming via buttons or mouse wheel (Ctrl + Wheel) rescales all paragraphs in the chronicle together, including the opening scene.
  • 🎲 Hybrid Dice Animation: Standard checks roll a decelerating typographic roulette (d4/d6/d8/d10/d12/d20), while high-stakes moments (0 HP / Death Saves, Rule of Cool, or Nat 20/1 crits) animate a geometric D20 crystal.
  • 🧠 Manual Memory (Right-Click): Highlight any phrase or dialogue in the chronicle and right-click to save it to an NPC's memory or the Campaign Journal.
  • 🔮 Arcane Genesis Ritual: When creating a new freeform or classic campaign, a grimoire modal overlay pulses with runes, rotating lore quotes every 2.5s, and real 4-phase progress (Cosmology → Hero → Allies/Map → Assembly).
  • 📜 Full Chronicle: Button in the chat header to search past turns and manage pinned memories (⭐).
  • 📦 Share Adventures: Export your hero as .json or full campaign as .zip, and import from Load Adventure or your sheet. Everything is validated locally before install and never overwrites existing saves. See the 📦 Share Saves tab for step-by-step instructions.
guide.tab_interface_html:
🏠 Main Menu

  • 🌟 New Adventure (Freeform Idea): write any premise, click one of the 4 inspiration ideas, or use 🎲 Generate random (AI) (makes a short LLM call and costs tokens). The engine builds the world, hero, allies, and map. Prefer your own character? Use 📥 Load Hero from File or 🛠️ Forge Sheet Manually: the world still springs from your premise, while your hero stays untouched. While the Genesis Ritual writes to disk, the dialog locks against accidental closing.
  • 🎲 New Adventure (Classic Mode): pick genre, tone, and optional hero archetype/name. With 📥 Load Hero from File your portable hero is preserved intact; ✖ clears it and returns to automatic generation.
  • 🛠️ Forge Sheet Manually: opens the 5-step SRD 5.1 builder (race, class, ability scores, gear/spells, and identity). Calculated deterministically in Python — racial bonuses, HP, armor AC, saves, and spell slots — spending zero AI tokens.
  • 📂 Load Saved Adventure: select a save to inspect its hero, location, companions, and «Previously on...» recap. Double-click, Enter, or ⚔️ Resume Adventure launches it. Footer also includes ⚙️ Settings, 🗖 maximize, and Back (Esc).
  • 🗑️ Manage Campaigns: management view offering Delete Campaign (with confirmation), 📜 Export PDF, 📦 Export ZIP, and 📥 Import Campaign.
  • 🔑 AI Keys (BYOK), 🔑 Import License (.cantrip) (Ctrl+L), ⚙️ Settings (Ctrl+,), 📖 Guide & Rules (F1), 🛠️ Help, and ☕ Ko-fi, plus the quick 🌐 ES / EN language switcher in the top bar and Supporter Edition preview buttons (🔒 / ✨).
  • When a newer release exists, a banner offers View notes and Update. The footer summarizes your saved adventures. ❌ Exit closes the app.

🏰 In-Game Top Bar

Buttons automatically wrap into extra rows if the window is narrow.

  • ⭐ Level Up: appears only when a level-up is available.
  • 📖 Guide (F1): opens this manual anytime.
  • 🔑 AI: opens the BYOK key and provider manager.
  • ⚙️ Settings (Ctrl+,): display, language, density, fonts, hints, undo, and memory.
  • 👤 Sheet (C): collapses or expands the side stats panel. Key C opens the full sheet modal.
  • 🗺️ Map (M): opens the live ASCII map in a resizable window.
  • 🛠️ Help: menu to share a sanitized campaign or report a bug.
  • ☕ Ko-fi: opens the project support page.
  • 📜 PDF: exports the full adventure (sheet, map, quests, and chronicle) to an editorial PDF.
  • 📦 ZIP / 📤 Hero: exports the full campaign or just your hero sheet. Full walkthrough in the 📦 Share Saves tab.
  • 🏰 Menu: asks whether to pause and save. Yes saves, writes a session closing recap, and returns to menu; No keeps playing.

Autosave: every turn is saved atomically to disk when completed. Session closing recaps are generated when returning to menu or exiting.

📜 Chronicle & Action Bar

  • 📖 View Full Chronicle: searchable turn history, PDF export, and 🧠 Memories & Journal tab.
  • ⬆️ Load earlier turns: appears when older turns are collapsed; each click prepends 10 turns.
  • − / + / ↺ and Ctrl + wheel: chronicle zoom; indicator shows active point size.
  • Verbosity: 🗡️ Concise, ⚖️ Balanced, or 📜 Immersive.
  • Style: ⚖️ Balanced, 🎯 Direct & Tactical, or 📑 Two Blocks.
  • 🔍 Hints: asks the DM to highlight interactive details without deciding for you.
  • 🔮 Fate, 🎲 Reroll (1 Fate), and ⏪ Undo turn: the first two spend fate; the third appears only when AI Assist / Undo is enabled in Settings, which also unlocks free /rewind, /deshacer, and /undo.
  • ⚡ Act / Enter: submits your written action to the Dungeon Master.

⌨️ Slash Commands You Can Type

/destino · [destino] Arms the next turn to spend 1 Fate Point (advantage + Rule of Cool).
/reroll · /relanzar Rerolls the last failed check (spends 1 Fate Point).
/rewind · /deshacer · /undo Rewinds to the previous turn. Free rewind requires «AI Assist & Turn Rewind» in Settings; otherwise use /destino /rewind for a Heroic Rewind (1 Fate Point).
/dm · dm: Out-of-character question consuming zero turns or game time. Clicking ❓ Ask DM opens the same floating panel.
/fidelidad Cumulative engine-to-prose fidelity audit report (zero turns).
/levelup · /subirnivel Checks level-up eligibility and enables the level-up alert button.

👤 Full Character Sheet (C)

  • Header: identity, ability scores, HP, AC, initiative, speed, and proficiency bonus.
  • Left column: saving throws, passive senses, and all 18 skills with modifiers.
  • ⚔️ Actions: weapons, unarmed strike, offensive cantrips, and RAW combat actions.
  • 🔮 Spells: cantrips, prepared/known spells, and spell slots.
  • 🎒 Inventory: items, condition, charges, weight, and gold value.
  • 🛡️ Features & Traits: class/race features, feats, personality traits, ideals, bonds, and flaws.
  • 📜 Notes: backstory, main quest, allies, enemies, and factions tracked in the campaign.
  • Footer: zoom 🔍 − / +, ↺ 100%, 📤 Export Hero, and ⚙️ Settings (native maximize and close in the title bar or Esc).

🎒 Inventory

  • Each item card shows name, category, weight, and condition; hover tooltip adds details.
  • Click an item for ⚔️ Use / Equip, 🔍 Inspect, ❓ Ask DM, or ✎ Personal note (roleplay-only note with no mechanical effect). Lore notes recorded by the DM and your personal notes appear in the tooltip and in the sheet's NOTES column.
  • ▲ Collapse / ▼ Expand saves vertical space; drag the splitter to reveal more rows.

📖 Full Chronicle & Memories

  • Search bar: filters across actions, prose, and dice logs.
  • 📜 Export Chronicle to PDF: generates a clean printable chronicle document.
  • 📊 Campaign Analytics (Supporter Edition): adds 🎲 Mis Dados (d20 histogram, d4–d100 table, streaks, and local readings), ✨ Ecos de la Campaña (Mirror of Fate, Star Map, Clutch Under Pressure, Close Calls, Rivals/Arsenal, and HP Lifeline), and 📊 La Partida (overview, 13 deterministic achievements, and local 🖼️ PNG Poster export), plus a local ⚔️ Session War Report on save & exit (100% local, zero AI).
  • 🧠 Memories & Journal: pinned campaign & NPC facts with ⭐ priority toggle and 🗑️ delete.
  • To add a memory, highlight text in the chronicle and right-click (see 🧭 Freedom, DM & Hints).

⭐ Level Up Wizard

  • Choose 🛡️ Take Average or 🎲 Roll Hit Die (single RAW roll).
  • Previews new spell slots, class features, and proficiency bonus.
  • Later postpones without saving; ⭐ Confirm & Level Up! applies the upgrade.

⚙️ Settings (Ctrl+,)

  • Updates: installed version & channel, 🔄 Check for updates, and diagnostic reasons if offline.
  • Language: Español or English. Hot-switches the entire interface and sets the Dungeon Master's narration language (applies from the next turn onward; past turns stay as written).
  • Density: Auto, Compact, Standard, or Wide.
  • Font Size: 11 to 16 pt for chronicle and panels, plus quick − / + controls next to chat.
  • Initial State: optionally start with map, inventory, or side sheet collapsed.
  • Window: 📱 Small Window (860x520), 🪄 Fit to Screen, and 🗖 Maximize.
  • Story Hints & Plateau: toggle stall detection and interval (5, 10, 15, or 20 turns).
  • Undo: enables the ⏪ Undo turn button (warns about meta-gaming).
  • Memory Strategy: Semantic Similarity, Hybrid with Pins, or Pure Recency.
  • 💾 Save & Apply keeps changes; Cancel discards them.

🔑 AI Keys (BYOK)

  • Providers: DeepSeek Direct, Groq Cloud, OpenRouter / Requesty, and Google Gemini AI Studio.
  • Pick your primary provider, paste keys, use 👁️ to show/hide, and 🔌 Test to verify latency.
  • 🌐 Get API Key opens the official provider portal. Keys go straight from your PC with zero proxy servers.
  • ⚡ Ephemeral Mode: keeps keys in RAM only and destroys them on exit.
  • 🗑️ Erase All My Keys: wipes keys from RAM and the OS keyring immediately.
  • Groq Free Tier: 8,000 TPM cap. For very heavy turns, add Gemini or DeepSeek as backup.
  • 🛡️ Security & Network Audit: strict HTTPS domain allowlist, keyring status, log redaction, and source audit link.
  • 🪪 License (Supporter Edition): dedicated tab to import an offline .cantrip license file, inspect licensee status and masked order details, or remove it cleanly.

🛠️ Help, Community & Support

  • 🧪 Share save to improve the engine: creates a sanitized .zip (stripped of API Keys and PC username) you can inspect before emailing.
  • 🐞 Report a bug: category, description, repro steps, and optional scrubbed technical summary.
  • ☕ Ko-fi: completely optional creator support.
guide.tab_fate_html:
🔮 What Are Fate Points?

Fate Points (shown on your blue fate bar) are a heroic meta-resource that lets you bend luck in decisive moments, channeling tabletop RPG's legendary «Rule of Cool».

⚡ How to Use Them

  1. Before a risky maneuver or decisive strike, click 🔮 Fate next to the input box (or type /destino).
  2. The button glows as armed.
  3. Type your heroic action and press Enter. Your hero burns 1 Fate Point to empower it.

🌟 Effects When Spending Fate

  • Automatic Advantage (2d20): The engine rolls two d20s and keeps the higher die.
  • 🎲 Reroll Failed Roll: After a failed attack, skill check, or save, click 🎲 Reroll (1 Fate) (or type /reroll) to re-resolve the full check with a fresh d20 and real consequences.
  • ⏳ Heroic Rewind: If a turn ends in disaster, type /destino /rewind to roll back to the previous turn at the cost of 1 Fate Point. Free rewind via /rewind / /undo requires enabling AI Assist in Settings.
  • Cinematic Resolution («Rule of Cool»): Instructs the AI narrator to reward bold creativity and improvisation.
  • Last Breath at 0 HP: Spending Fate at death's door helps you cling to life and dodge a lethal blow.

⏪ AI Assist & Turn Undo (Keep-Inventory Mode)

In ⚙️ Settings you can toggle «AI Assist & Turn Rewind», unlocking a discreet ⏪ Undo turn button and free /rewind, /deshacer, and /undo commands to recover from AI hallucinations without penalizing your hero.

🔄 Recharging Fate Points

  • Completing a Long Rest (8 hours) in safety.
  • Rolling a Natural 20 Critical Success on any check or attack!
  • Silver-lining consolation on a Natural 1 Fumble in skill checks!

⚖️ Karmic Dice (Cold-Streak Protection)

To prevent miserable statistical cold streaks, Cantrip features Karmic Dice (inspired by Baldur's Gate 3): after 2 or more consecutive mechanical failures, low d20 rolls quietly reroll and take the higher outcome.
guide.tab_freedom_html:
🎭 Total Narrative Freedom

Unlike rigid dialogue-tree RPGs, here you have complete freedom. Type whatever your hero tries:

  • «I try to bluff the innkeeper with my cracked amulet, claiming a necromancer is hunting me.»
  • «I climb the ceiling rafters to ambush the orc from above with my dagger.»
  • «I carefully examine the wall runes for a hidden latch.»

The engine parses your intent, checks your D&D 5e skills (Deception, Stealth, Athletics, etc.), and resolves the dice deterministically.

⚙️ The Engine Is World Authority

Prose never overrides numbers: your HP and Fate are real, slain foes stay dead on the floor, locked cells must be opened via mechanics, and you can only wield gear in your inventory. Whenever the narrator contradicts state, the engine catches and rewrites the scene cleanly so story and sheet always match.

Objects & doors aren't monsters: smashing a chest, door, or prison bars damages the object or triggers a breakout check rather than inventing fake enemies. Empty looted chests stay empty, and missing targets are rejected. Keys are real too: doors only auto-open if a real key sits in your inventory or a present NPC unlocks it.

🛡️ Cautious & Preventive Actions ("Check before touching...")

You can safely scout or test hypotheses first (e.g., «I check for traps before opening the chest», «Arcana check to see if the rune will explode if touched»). Failing a cautious probe—even a Nat 1—only means uncertainty, never accidental self-detonation.

❓ Out-of-Character DM Questions (/dm)

Need a rules clarification, lore recall, or environment clue? Click ❓ Ask DM or type in chat:

/dm what do I know about the creatures lurking in this marsh?

This opens a floating side modal (like /btw) consuming zero turns, zero in-game time, and zero chronicle clutter. If the DM's answer defines a sheet detail (deity, oath, backstory), it updates and saves automatically. Q&A history is archived in Chronicle → ❓ OOC Questions.

🛡️ Engine ↔ Prose Fidelity (/fidelidad)

Every turn is audited twice: deterministic state guards + a structured narrator check that triggers instant rewrites if the AI overpromises. Type /fidelidad anytime to inspect campaign stats without spending a turn.

🧭 Stuck? (Plateau Detection & Fail Forward)

If you hit a dead end looking for a key or clue, the engine protects pacing:

  • 🧭 Hints Button: Request a subtle clue anytime from the bottom bar.
  • Automatic Stall Detection (4-turn window): Tracks real progress (rooms, combat, loot, HP). After 4 stalled turns, the button highlights as 🧭 Stuck? and the DM sharpens hooks to restore momentum.
  • Fail Forward: Repeating the same skill check in the same room after failing never deadlocks—the engine forces a complication or scene shift instead.

🧠 Assisted Memory & Pinning (Beat AI Amnesia)

Old turns are pruned to save tokens, so lock critical facts into memory:

  • Right-Click Highlighted Text: Assign any quote to a nearby NPC or Campaign Journal; the AI distills an editable one-line fact.
  • Prompt Strategies in Settings (Ctrl+,): Choose Semantic Similarity, Hybrid (Pin-priority), or Pure Recency.
  • Manage in Chronicle: Inspect, star (⭐), or delete pinned memories anytime under Memories & Journal.
guide.tab_combat_html:
⚔️ Tactical D&D 5e Combat

  • Initiative: Entering combat sets turn order using your Dexterity modifier.
  • Armor Class (AC): Attacks below your AC glance off or miss.
  • Defend: Taking a defensive stance grants +2 AC temporarily.
  • Flee: Attempt a tactical retreat to a previously explored exit or room.

🛌 Rests & Survival

  • Short Rest (1 hour): Catch your breath safely out of combat; if stabilized at 0 HP out of combat, resting wakes you at 1 HP.
  • Long Rest (8 hours): Make camp safely out of combat to restore full HP, spell slots, and Fate Points. (Resting in hostile territory risks night ambushes.)
  • 0 HP & Defeat: Fall unconscious and roll Death Saving Throws (3 successes stabilize, 3 failures mean death). Against active foes alone, combat may resolve into a finishing blow, capture (with containment and confiscated gear), truce, or being left behind out of combat.

⭐ Level Up

Defeating foes, overcoming traps, and hitting story milestones earns Experience Points (XP):

  • Once ready to advance, a golden ⭐ Level Up button appears in the top bar.
  • Click it to launch the wizard, roll Hit Dice (or take average) for permanent Max HP, and unlock new class features and spell slots.
guide.tab_share_html:
📦 Two Ways to Share

  • Hero (.json): a standalone character sheet with stats, level, inventory, spells, gold, and background. Great for reusing your hero or sharing with friends.
  • Full Campaign (.zip): the entire adventure with its world, map, turn history, journal, NPCs, and state.

📤 Export Your Hero

  1. During play open 📦 More → 📤 Hero in the top bar, or press C and click 📤 Export Hero.
  2. Pick folder and filename to save a portable .json.

📥 Import a Hero

In a new campaign: click 📥 Load Hero from File (Classic or Freeform), review the preview, and confirm (✖ clears it back to auto-generation).

Note: only Cantrip-exported hero files (cantrip.hero) are accepted.

📦 Export Full Campaign

  1. From menu: Load Adventure → select run → 📦 Export ZIP.
  2. In-game: open 📦 More → 📦 ZIP in the top bar.

Includes state, sheet, map, world bible, chronicle, memories, and NPCs. Excludes API keys, debug/ logs, .bak backups, and PDFs.

📥 Import a Campaign

  1. Open Load Adventure and click 📥 Import Campaign.
  2. Pick a .zip, inspect the preview, and confirm.

Never overwrites an existing save: colliding folders automatically get a _2, _3… suffix.

🔐 Security & Privacy

  • 100% local: no uploads and zero token cost.
  • ZIP manifests, paths (blocking ../, absolute paths, symlinks), hashes, and zip-bomb limits are verified before extraction.
